title: ArchaeoTrace: Local-First AI-Assisted Contour Tracing and Historical Terrain Reconstruction for QGIS
description: Open-source, local-first QGIS plugin (QGIS 3.22–4.99, Qt5/Qt6) for human-reviewed vectorization of elevation contours from scanned historical topographic maps and experimental linear-TIN DEM/hillshade reconstruction. Combines multi-scale Ink Centerline v2 (9/15/31px) with bounded direction-aware Live-Wire, literal 0–100% cursor-to-path blending, cubic Hermite gap bridging, ink-colour and avoid-region guidance, optional fail-closed EfficientSAM-Ti Smart Recovery and ResNet-18 dual-head U-Net learned contour guidance (ONNX Runtime), advanced/legacy backends (LSD, HED, MobileSAM, SAM ViT-B, Canny), and a bilingual Korean/English interface without uploading archival map data to external inference servers.
